description: This PHP class 'EmployeeImmigrationRecordService' provides various methods to manage employee immigration records within the OrangeHRM system. It acts as a service layer that interfaces with the data access object (DAO) for performing CRUD operations and searches related to employee immigration records.

classes.name: EmployeeImmigrationRecordService
classes.description: Service class to handle employee immigration record operations, utilizing DAO for data persistence.

methods.name: getEmployeeImmigrationRecordDao
methods.description: Lazy loader for the EmployeeImmigrationRecordDao instance.

methods.name: getEmployeeImmigrationRecord
methods.description: Retrieves a specific employee immigration record by employee number and record number.

methods.name: getEmployeeImmigrationRecordList
methods.description: Retrieves a list of all immigration records for a given employee.

methods.name: saveEmployeeImmigrationRecord
methods.description: Saves a new or existing employee immigration record.

methods.name: deleteEmployeeImmigrationRecords
methods.description: Deletes specified immigration records for an employee based on sequence numbers.

methods.name: searchEmployeeImmigrationRecords
methods.description: Searches employee immigration records based on filter parameters.

methods.name: getSearchEmployeeImmigrationRecordsCount
methods.description: Returns the count of records matching search filter criteria.
